name: inkwire
description: Local MCP server + shared drawing canvas for collaborating visually with an AI agent on a codebase.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node esbuild.ui.mjs && node scripts/write-build-id.mjs
scripts.dev: INKWIRE_PORT=4692 INKWIRE_DATA_DIR=$HOME/.inkwire-dev INKWIRE_IDLE_GRACE_MS=off node esbuild.ui.mjs --watch & INKWIRE_PORT=4692 INKWIRE_DATA_DIR=$HOME/.inkwire-dev INKWIRE_IDLE_GRACE_MS=off tsx watch src/server/daemon.ts
scripts.health: yarn build && INKWIRE_HEALTH=1 vitest run tests/health tests/link tests/server/idle.test.ts tests/tools/clients.test.ts tests/tools/project-root.test.ts tests/tools/forward-hook.test.ts tests/tools/authorship.test.ts tests/integration/port-conflict.test.ts tests/integration/daemon.test.ts
